## Open Risks / Caveats

- Widget stubs render raw JSON — this is intentional for UoW-05. Concrete widget implementations are per-UoW (UoW-07 through UoW-12).
- SSE integration test requires running BE orchestrator (UoW-06). UoW-05 tests use mock/stub SSE handlers.
- `shadcn/ui` not installed in UoW-05 — raw Tailwind used. shadcn components can be added in UoW-06 or later.
